assertions.description: MediaSession.prototype.setMicrophoneActive is a function (the operation whose return type changed).
MediaSession.prototype.setCameraActive is a function (the operation whose return type changed).
navigator.mediaSession.setMicrophoneActive(false) returns a Promise (it returned undefined before the IDL change).
navigator.mediaSession.setCameraActive(false) returns a Promise (it returned undefined before the IDL change).
In a fully active document both promises fulfil with undefined.
assertions.test: (async () => { const a = navigator.mediaSession.setMicrophoneActive(false); const b = navigator.mediaSession.setCameraActive(false); if (!(a instanceof Promise) || !(b instanceof Promise)) return false; return (await a) === undefined && (await b) === undefined; })()

assertions.description: On a MediaSession whose document is no longer fully active (its iframe was removed), setMicrophoneActive() returns a promise rejected with InvalidStateError instead of silently returning undefined.
assertions.test: (async () => { const f = document.createElement('iframe'); document.body.append(f); const ms = f.contentWindow.navigator.mediaSession; f.remove(); const r = ms.setMicrophoneActive(false); if (!r || typeof r.then !== 'function') return false; try { await r; return false; } catch (e) { return e.name === 'InvalidStateError'; } })()

assertions.description: As a promise-returning WebIDL operation, a missing argument no longer throws synchronously: setCameraActive() returns a promise rejected with TypeError.
assertions.test: (async () => { const r = navigator.mediaSession.setCameraActive(); if (!(r instanceof Promise)) return false; try { await r; return false; } catch (e) { return e instanceof TypeError; } })()
